summary: Variants should distinguish continuous executable conformance from slower semantic review and keep the authority decision explicit.

items.text: Run cheap contract and architecture checks per change, then a broader prose and roadmap comparison as a scheduled sweep.
When implementation changes intentionally, propose the reciprocal specification update in the same delivery unit.
Link accepted divergences to a versioned decision record with owner and expiry rather than suppressing them silently.
Emit high-confidence drift as a blocking gate and ambiguous semantic drift as an advisory review result.
